RBI/2024-25/88 - Prudential Norms on Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning pertaining to Advances

Ref.No.DoS.CO.PPG./03.01.001/2024-25 October 11, 2024 Department of Supervision

Please refer to the Master Circular DOR.No.STR.REC.5/21.04.048/2023-24 dated April 01, 2023 on the captioned subject.

All Scheduled Commercial Banks (excluding Regional Rural Banks), Small Finance Banks, and Non-Banking Financial Companies are advised to maintain enhanced risk-weight provisioning on unsecured retail portfolios exceeding regulatory thresholds.

The revised instructions shall come into force with immediate effect.
